items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He'd really do that, man. He'd say, you know, 'Great to see you.' And his wife could do it, you know. But my wife... He always had great respect for Mona.

ctx.x: Looked like a lot of people right here in New Orleans.

Excuse me. I can remember when I was working with Louis, little old ladies would come backstage to see him, you know. They were sixty-five and he didn't know them when he was a young man, and they would just stop back by the stage to see him.
